title: Buy-trigger ablation (NORMAL buy / EXFEAR buy) - diagnostic only
model: Claude Sonnet 5.5 (as designated by the request; actual selection depends on the runtime)
question: With one buy trigger suppressed at a time, how do purchase dates and terminal market-value total change for fixed NO_SELL / P20_ONLY profiles? Not a threshold search, no strategy adoption.

fixed.inputs_and_dividends_and_costs_and_mmf: unchanged from 77bb44f source_refs; no new data fetched, interpolated or replaced

counts.reused_note: 9 main (3 profiles x ... ) -> 6 both-ON/reference candidates x 12 = 72; new = 6 OFF candidates x 12 = 72
counts.regression_detail: 2 starts (2024-10-01, 2025-01-02) x 3 main profiles x 2 delays = 12 conditions; original engine 12 + copy 12 (copy both flags ON: 6 explicit true, 6 omitted)
counts.main_event_paths: 2 main starts x 3 profiles x 3 settings x 2 delays = 36; 24 new from main computation memory, 12 both-ON from regression copy runs

unchanged: armed/streak/prevNormal state (an EXFEAR episode is consumed even if its order is suppressed)
initial trend and after-sale reentry I/R/cooldown conditions
engine_change.interpretation_note: When the NORMAL/EXFEAR order is suppressed the code would evaluate the reentry branch next; by construction of signals() reCandidate (f>=30, rsi>55) cannot coincide with ex (f<25) or normal (rsi<=55), so no suppressed day can turn into a reentry order. The run verifies this on every input day.
engine_change.no_additive_attribution: Differences are not additive contributions or causal effects: sale dates and reinvestment capacity change as paths diverge.

checks: regression original vs copy (summary original fields, ledger, daily, candidates, signals, cfg except new flags; USD tolerance 1e-6, dates/types/shares/status exact)

signals identical across all flag settings; episode consumption/re-arm and normal rise history identical; sale priority and I/R separation preserved
fg_used from signals(delay) only, never raw D.fg at delay 1; D vs proxy exec date; suppressed vs insufficient vs filled separate; zero-share reason = allocation budget vs one share at exec Open + fee
ranking: rank_in_current_12 per start x delay (ties share rank, tol 1e-7); source ranks (18 / 21 candidate studies) in separate columns with source names; no win counts, average rank, drawdown penalty or pooling across starts.
